effects.compile: One pinned core-lib compiler invocation, proc macros/dependency build scripts and C compiler/linker; online locked preparation precedes offline compile. No project command is executed during metadata preparation.
effects.tests: Eight existing cases only: four same-binary child lifecycle regressions, then four service shutdown/receiver cases. Two intentional source panics, one visible outer panic hook. Service fixtures use SQLite and libgit2 init; no live Git/SVN/HTTP/provider fixtures.
effects.network: Online exact toolchain/dependency preparation; Cargo offline for compile/tests is not OS network isolation
effects.git: Private HOME, empty template/hooks, per-command no-system/global config; no credentials forwarded to build/tests
effects.credentials: Read-only checkout token not persisted; no repository/environment secrets or OIDC requested; artifact runtime credentials remain confined to action steps
effects.inventory: Run selected libtest binary with --list only; require eight exact names once and bind inventory to binary digest; no test body selected.
effects.jobs: Two Cargo build jobs; per-process prlimit values are inherited by descendants, not aggregate VM quotas. Native GitHub step/job bounds and fresh-VM disposal own descendant containment.

completion.authority: GitHub native step/job cancellation and fresh-VM decommission; no custom process supervisor
completion.cancellation: Documented SIGINT 7.5s, SIGTERM 2.5s, process-tree kill; server cancellation procedure up to five minutes. No earlier 5+2s guarantee.
completion.stdout_eof: Not a completion oracle; logs use regular files and native step conclusion is required
completion.unknown: RUNNING without an exit becomes INCOMPLETE; unstarted cases NOT_RUN; no campaign PASS without external terminal job/run readback
completion.artifact_upload: Best effort on cancellation; bounded sanitized evidence only; uploaded data inherits public repository access
completion.rerun: Frozen first-attempt tag only; meaningful corrections use focused review, updated exact identity and a fresh tag under the standing correction/test cycle. No blind rerun or manual dispatch.

compile.scope: One exact core library libtest artifact, default features plus manifest dev-dependency test-support; no reliability-fixture feature, workspace/all-targets compile, doctest or integration-test invocation

requirements.requirement: Healthy ordinary invocations remain independent; closed case refuses work before it runs.
Cancelled invocation and cancelled observer retain real handle/receiver, original result 37, and context until observed completion.
Panic is terminal, consumed handle is never repolled, case cannot qualify, ordinary work still completes.
Intentional inner error is joined work, not a fabricated JoinError or publication-success receipt.
Actual shutdown worker/publisher custody survives cancellation, Pending/Failed never count as completed, receiver-close releases only proved nonholding work.
